changes.old: Medium shot at a wooden reading desk in New York in 1835, one fully grown newspaper buyer in his forties with mature facial features and a plain 1830s waistcoat reaches for a thin unlettered booklet beside a blank broadsheet, soft window light
changes.new: Medium close shot at an 1835 New York newspaper counter, one fully grown grey-haired middle-aged reader with sideburns and a high-collar 1830s coat lifts a small thin unlettered paper booklet from the bare wooden counter, a large blank broadsheet lies flat beside it, daylight from an open shopfront
